staff.overviewTableProductsColumn: Product(s) eligible for the staff discount
staff.conditionsDescription:
All employees of AVANIS (permanent, temporary, interns, and apprentices) can benefit from this discount (from their arrival and throughout their contract).



The purchase of one or more products, with the application of the discount, is reserved exclusively for employees and their household (partner and children) and for non-profit/resale purposes.



Regarding payment, the order must be paid with a payment method in the name of the employee.



For your information, the discount is calculated according to the following rule: up to 30% discount compared to the Alltricks selling price and within the limit of the cost price for Alltricks and a maximum reduction of 40% on the recommended retail price.



The discount applies all year round and on all products sold by Alltricks.



The staff discount cannot be combined with other promotional codes, Alltricks+ cashback, or gift vouchers obtained through Troc Vélo sales.



The order limit is set at €5,000 per calendar year excluding adult bikes per employee.



Regarding adult bikes, you have the option to purchase up to two adult bikes per calendar year* and with no limit on the amount.



*limited to one adult bike for a contract/tenure of six months or less in the company.
